spec.name: zeb/threejs-vrm
spec.description: VRM 0.x/1.0 avatar viewer for RWE templates. Three.js + @pixiv/three-vrm bundled offline. Auto-mount, expression control, animation mixer, look-at, spring bones.

full-3.x.note: Three.js r186 (three@0.186.1) + @pixiv/three-vrm 3.5.5 via esbuild. Build: npm install (0.1/runtime/package.json) && node_modules/.bin/esbuild entry.mjs --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=threejs-vrm.bundle.mjs
